workflows.name: Propose a business-trip hotel and its cost in the traveler's home currency
steps: In the Booking.com tab, click the destination box, type {city}, set the dates {checkin} to {checkout} and click Search
Open the first hotel with a review score of 8 or more and note its name and total price. Do not click Reserve or I'll reserve
Switch to the xe.com tab, set Amount to that total price, From to EUR and To to {currency}, click Convert and read the result
Switch to the Mail tab, click To and type {traveler}@example.com, click Subject and type "Hotel for {city}, {checkin}-{checkout}"
Click Body and type "Hi {traveler}, proposed hotel: <name>, <total> EUR (about <converted> {currency}). OK to book?" Do not click Send. Click Discard

workflows.name: Check visa rules and local public holidays for a traveler's destination
steps: In the Wikipedia tab, click the search box, type "Visa requirements for {nationality} citizens" and open that article
Find the row for {country} in the table and note the visa requirement and the allowed stay
Switch to the timeanddate tab, open the Holidays menu, pick {country}, and note the public holidays in {month}
Switch to Notes, click "New note", type "{nationality} traveler to {country}: <requirement>, <allowed stay>. Holidays in {month}: <dates>" and press Enter

workflows.name: Send a traveler a weather and disruption heads-up before departure
steps: In the weather.com tab, click the search box, type {city}, pick it from the list and open the 10 Day forecast
Note the high, low and conditions for {date}
Switch to the BBC tab, click Search, type "{city} strike" and press Enter; open the first result and note its headline and date
Switch to the Mail tab, click To and type {traveler}@example.com, click Subject and type "Heads-up: {city} on {date}"
Click Body and type "Hi {traveler}, {city} on {date}: <high>/<low>, <conditions>. Latest news: <headline> (<date>)." Do not click Send. Click Discard

STAY.3.note: In step 1, first type "Amsterdma", notice the typo, fix it to "Amsterdam", then continue

noise.N1: Open a new tab, go to news.ycombinator.com, scroll the front page, open one comment thread, close the tab
noise.N2: Open a new tab, go to imdb.com, scroll the home page, open one title, skim it, close the tab
noise.N3: Abandoned attempt: in the Booking.com tab, type Zurich in the destination box, open the date picker, then give up and press Escape
noise.N4: Wander: click through the Notes, Mail and xe.com tabs without doing anything, scroll the Notes list
noise.N5: In the Wikipedia tab, click Random article in the menu, skim it and scroll a bit
